name: Mark Lanier
tagline: Top rated Class Action & Mass Torts attorney in Houston, Texas
education: Texas Tech University School of Law
about: Mark Lanier is the founder of The Lanier Law Firm, with offices in New York, Houston, and Los Angeles. Lanier's reputation as one of the country's top trial lawyers is based on courtroom battles involving some of the world's largest companies. Lanier won the nation's first verdict over the controversial pain medication VIOXX, and helped clear the way for a nationwide settlement for all VIOXX users. Lanier and his team are recognized in prestigious legal journals based on their work in intellectual property and business litigation, and claims involving toxic exposures, serious personal injuries, dangerous prescription drugs, defective products, medical malpractice and maritime law.

honors: Mark’s peers and the media consistently recognize him among the country’s leading legal minds. In July 2018, Mark's $4.69 Billion verdict against Johnson & Johnson was the largest verdict in the country, as reported by VerdictSearch . The National Law Journal has twice named him one of the nation’s Top 10 Trial Attorneys , as well as one of the 100 Most Influential Lawyers in America of the Decade. In 2018, NLJ named Mark Outstanding Trial Lawyer of the Year and Law360 recognized him on the elite list of MVPs for his work in Products Liability Litigation. In 2017, Mark was inducted into the Trial Lawyer Hall of Fame, by National Trial Lawyers. In December 2016, Lanier secured a verdict of more than $1 billion on behalf of six people who suffered serious medical complications caused by defective metal-on-metal hip implants made by Johnson & Johnson and its subsidiary DePuy Orthopaedics Inc. The verdict includes more than $30 million in actual damages for the six plaintiffs and more than $1 billion in punitive damages. In March 2016, he secured a multi-million dollar verdict in federal court in the initial bellwether trial against DePuy and Johnson & Johnson over defective metal-on-metal hip implants. The December verdict ranks as the fourth largest in the nation in 2016 , according to VerdictSearch and The National Law Journal, and both trial wins are ranked as the two largest products liability verdicts of the year . As a result, the firm received the “Outstanding Medical Device Award.” In February 2015, NLJ named Mark and The Lanier Law Firm to their Plaintiff’s Hot List . The New York Times described him as “one of the top civil trial lawyers in America…” In October of 2012, he was awarded the coveted Clarence Darrow Award . Best Lawyers has named Mark Lanier to its Best Lawyers in America list since 2006, and as Lawyer of the Year in 2020 for Plaintiffs Product Liability Litigation, Lawyer of the Year in 2018 for Mass Torts/Class Actions, and Lawyer of the Year in 2017 and 2024 for Plaintiffs Personal Injury Litigation. He was also named Lawyer of the Year in 2012, 2016 and 2024 for Plaintiffs Mass Tort Litigation/Class Actions. He has been recognized as a Litigation Star in Benchmark Litigation in 2013- 2022. He has earned similar honors from other publications, including being named to The Trial Lawyer Magazine’s America’s 100 Most Influential Trial Lawyers of 2011 and he was selected as the 2015-2019 Trial Lawyer of the Year by The National Trial Lawyers and The Trial Lawyer magazine. Mark also earned a spot in Chambers USA: America’s Leading Lawyers for Business list in 2012-2021. He also received special recognition as one of their “Leaders in Their Field” based on his work in product liability and mass tort cases. This annual guide to the best lawyers in the U.S. uses researchers to conduct independent interviews with thousands of lawyers and law firm clients. It is also noteworthy that U.S. News and World Report has named The Lanier Law Firm to its list of Best Law Firms over the last five years. In addition to national recognition, Mark Lanier has earned accolades from his peers in Texas. In a statewide attorney survey published in Texas Monthly magazine, Mark Lanier has earned selection to the “Texas Super Lawyers” list in 2003 through 2023, by Thomson Reuters. Further he has been recognized, in “Texas Super Lawyers” , as one of the Top 10 Attorneys in Texas. In 2002, 2007 and 2012, Texas Lawyer newspaper named Mark Lanier among the Top 5 “Go-To” Personal Injury Plaintiff Attorneys in Texas. In the 2007 and 2012 editions of the same publication, which is published every five years, he was named The Top “Go-To” Personal Injury Attorney statewide. Mark is also the Recipient of the Texas Bar Foundation’s 2015 Ronald D. Secrest Outstanding Trial Lawyer Award .
